text:
“An alchemist called Sun runs after you, Daphne—and are you so cruel? You turn bat, fleeing Sun and light.


“He wants you if he catches you in this rough wood; quiver rattles, purse is mute, dog dies.


“Peddler of signs and planets, he gestures, loaded with blushes and comets.”


I told her; she grafted herself into laurel bark, and Sun remained pickled in darkness.

translation.title: To Daphne, Fleeing Apollo
